en.title: Fortnite Override Launches Aug. 20: Sonic and Mega Man Arrive!
en.summary: Get ready, Loopers! Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, titled 'Override,' is set to drop on August 20, 2026, bringing a wave of gaming legends to the island. This highly anticipated season promises a fresh Battle Pass and exciting new mechanics.
en.body:
The wait is almost over! Epic Games has officially confirmed that **Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4**, known as **Override**, will launch on **Thursday, August 20, 2026**. This highly anticipated update follows a period where players will have a few extra days to wrap up their current Battle Pass following the conclusion of Chapter 7 Season 3's story during the **Unstable** event on August 15th. The transition into **Override** is set to be one of the most significant yet, with the island poised for a radical transformation.

While details are still emerging, the theme of **Override** strongly suggests a massive crossover event celebrating gaming history. Dataminers and community speculation have been rampant, but Epic's official announcement on X (formerly Twitter) has put many rumors to rest, confirming the August 20th release date. The buzz around this season is palpable, especially with the confirmed inclusion of "gaming legends" like **Sonic the Hedgehog** and **Mega Man**. Players can expect a brand-new Battle Pass filled with unique skins and cosmetic items inspired by these beloved characters, alongside potentially new gameplay mechanics that tie into the **Override** theme.

## A New Era of Collaborations

The arrival of **Sonic** and **Mega Man** marks a significant moment for **Fortnite**, pushing its crossover strategy into even more legendary territory. These aren't just characters; they represent decades of gaming history and are icons to millions worldwide. The **Override** season is shaping up to be a love letter to the gaming community, offering fans the chance to see their childhood heroes clash and coexist within the **Fortnite** universe. Beyond the skins, the community is eager to discover what new points of interest, LTMs (Limited Time Modes), or even narrative twists **Override** might introduce. The potential for further "gaming legend" collaborations beyond the initial reveal is also a hot topic, with fans already dreaming up their ultimate wishlists.

## What to Expect in Override

The transition from Chapter 7 Season 3 to Season 4 will officially begin on August 20th, with the in-game season ending on August 19th. This gives players a clear timeline to maximize their progress in the current season before the new content drops. The **Override** season promises not just new aesthetics but also a fresh gameplay experience, as Epic Games consistently innovates with each major update. Whether it's through new weapons, map changes, or innovative mechanics that complement the crossover theme, **Fortnite** players have every reason to be excited for what **Override** brings to the island.

content_raw: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, Override, will launch in the latter half of August 2026. Epic Games officially revealed the name and release date on Aug. 5. This season is shaping up to be one of the biggest ever with iconic video game characters, fresh mechanics, and a fresh Battle Pass.
